notes.title: We are back! With release v1.05
notes.notes: Updated game engine, fixed homing bug with the Friend ship, fixed saving and loading waves, better resource picking up, the Frost ship, and much more...

notes.title: Menu / Control Improvements and Balance Patch
notes.notes:
v1.02:
Some menu and UI improvements, more flexibility for single-keyboard play, wave improvements, and a couple of bug fixes including better analog stick support.

Feature Updates!
x Added the starfield to main menu and logo loading. It now persists throughout all menus and modes, unifying the look of the game a bit more.
x P1 Keyboard player now supports F and G for left and right (this means that Keyboard P4 and P1 can more easily share a single keyboard).
x The controller layouts are now shown in the options or paused screens when the 'Controller Layout' option is selected (instead of displaying them in the main menu).
x Added 'use directional first' in certain kinds of menus to prevent misclicks.
x Added some slight action delay when pausing the game to prevent misclicks.
x All ships in versus mode have shields on during between wave countdowns to minimize griefing while selecting ships and between waves.
x The in-between wave timer is now 10 seconds instead of 700 frames
x New players spawned in the middle of a wave start out destroyed and must be repaired by allies

Bugfixes:
x Game now counts destroyed ships properly for game over even if there are extra AI
x When using an Analog stick, the acceleration and fuel usage now depends on hard you tilt up
x Waves do not start if other players are still selecting a ship
x Enemies won't spawn while players are between waves
